column1: # List prices in US dollars per million tokens, used by tools/port-cost.py ONLY when Claude Code
# recorded no dollar figure (its desktop/CLI build writes tokens, not dollars). A row priced this way is
# marked usd_source=estimated. Add a row when a port runs on a model that isn't here; a model with no
# row leaves the dollars blank rather than guessing. Thinking is billed as output and is already
# counted inside output_tokens. Cache writes: 5-minute = 1.25x input, 1-hour = 2x input.
# source: Anthropic API list prices (first-party), as of the date in the as_of column.
# claude-haiku-5-5 is priced by PROMPT LENGTH: these are the rates for a request of <=100K input tokens; a
# longer request pays 5x on every column (0.50 / 2.50 / 0.05 / ...). The per-model estimate below assumes
# the short tier -- right for file-loop's single-shot workers, an underestimate for a long agent session.
# Checked 2026-10-08 against Claude Code's own recorded costUSD on two probes (exact match, incl. 1h writes).
